STATEMENT TO BE DELIVERED

                         BY

                 MR. HAKAINDE HICHILEMA

          PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF ZAMBIA

   DURING THE GENERAL DEBATE OF THE 77TH SESSION OF

         THE UNITED NATIONS GENERAL ASSEMBLY

              ON 21ST SEPTEMBER 2022





STATE HOUSE

LUSAKA





SEPTEMBER, 2022

1




e YOUR EXCELLENCY, AMBASSADOR CSABA KOROSI, PRESIDENT

  OF THE 77T SESSION OF THE UNITED NATIONS GENERAL

  ASSEMBLY;


e YOUR EXCELLENCY MR. ANTONIO GUTERRES, SECRETARY-

  GENERAL OF THE UNITED NATIONS;



e YOUR EXCELLENCIES HEADS OF STATE AND GOVERNMENT;



e DISTINGUISHED LADIES AND GENTLEMEN.



WE CONGRATULATE YOU, MR. PRESIDENT, ON YOUR ELECTION AS

THE PRESIDENT OF THE 77™SESSION OF THE UNITED NATIONS

GENERAL ASSEMBLY.



WITH YOUR VAST EXPERIENCE, WE ARE CONFIDENT THAT YOU

WILL SUCCESSFULLY  PROVIDE THE  REQUIRED  LEADERSHIP

DURING  YOUR TENURE  AS  PRESIDENT  OF THE  GENERAL

ASSEMBLY.

2



WE PAY TRIBUTE TO HIS EXCELLENCY MR. ABDULLA SHAHID FOR

HIS UNWAVERING  DEDICATION AND GOOD  STEWARDSHIP

DURING THE 76™SESSION.





MR. PRESIDENT, EXCELLENCIES,



WE MEET HERE AT A DIFFICULT TIME.



A TIME WHEN GLOBAL CHALLENGES HAVE NOT ONLY MULTIPLIED,

BUT HAVE BECOME MORE COMPLEX. SUCH CHALLENGES INCLUDE:



   e THE COVID-19 CRISIS,

   e CLIMATE CHANGE,

   e UKRAINE WAR AND ASSOCIATED  EFFECTS ON SUPPLY

    CHAINS,

   e FOOD INSECURITY,

   e HIGH COMMODITY AND ENERGY PRICES,

   e AS WELL AS THE OVERALL HIGH COST OF LIVING....



CAST A DARK SHADOW OVER THE ATTAINMENT OF THE SDGS.

3



THE RISK OF REVERSAL IN HARD-WON DEVELOPMENTAL GAINS IS

EVER SO REAL.



COVID-19  UNMASKED  THE  GLOBAL  INEQUALITIES,  WHICH

STRETCH WELL BEYOND INCOME AND POLITICAL BOUNDARIES,

AS EVIDENCED THROUGH VARIED ACCESS TO VACCINES.



THE RISK OF FURTHER INEQUALITY IS ALSO REAL, ESPECIALLY

FOR US DEVELOPING COUNTRIES, WHICH HAVE INADEQUATE

CAPACITY TO ADAPT AND MITIGATE THE EFFECTS OF CLIMATE

CHANGE, DESPITE OUR INSIGNIFICANT CARBON FOOTPRINT.



THIS IS TRULY A DEFINING MOMENT OF OUR TIME, WHERE

COLLECTIVE EFFORTS MUST BE CHANNELLED TO ADDRESS THE

NUMEROUS CHALLENGES, WE FACE.



MR. PRESIDENT,



THAT IS WHY ZAMBIA WELCOMES THE CHALLENGE ON BUILDING

“OUR COMMON AGENDA” AND ENDORSE THE CALL TO CONVENE

THE “SUMMIT OF THE FUTURE”.

4




WE CALL FOR THE ATTAINMENT OF A “PACT FOR THE FUTURE”

THAT UNDERWRITES A NEW FORM OF MULTILATERALISM.



ONE WHERE MAJOR CHALLENGES ARE FACED TOGETHER, IN

SOLIDARITY,  WITHIN  A  CONTEXT  OF    A_  REVITALIZED

INTERNATIONAL ORDER THAT  IS  RULES-BASED,  FAIR AND

INCLUSIVE, WITH THE UNITED NATIONS AT THE CENTRE OF IT.



AS A COUNTRY WITH TWO-THIRDS OF THE POPULATION BELOW

THE AGE OF 25, THE OUTLOOK ON THE FUTURE AND EMPHASIS ON

INTERGENERATIONAL EQUITY IS VERY IMPORTANT TO US.



OUR GOVERNMENT SEEKS TO HARNESS THIS DEMOGRAPHIC

DIVIDEND BY INVESTING IN ITS YOUTHFUL AND ENERGETIC

POPULATION FOR A BETTER FUTURE.



WE, THEREFORE, SUPPORT THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE UN

YOUTH OFFICE.

5





THIS SHOULD ENCOURAGE MEANINGFUL YOUTH ENGAGEMENT IN

DIVERSE WAYS, SUCH AS  IN  POLITICAL  REPRESENTATION,

ACCESS TO  LIFELONG  SKILLS TRAINING AND  EDUCATION,

SUPPORT TO YOUTH INNOVATION AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP AND

INDEED  IN DECISION-MAKING  IN MANY AREAS INCLUDING

CLIMATE-CHANGE AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.



MR. PRESIDENT,



IN SPITE OF THE STEADY PROGRESS MADE TOWARDS CURBING

THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC, WE STILL NEED TO REMAIN VIGILANT

TO GUARD AGAINST THE POSSIBILITY OF ITS RESURGENCE.




WE HAVE ALL EXPERIENCED THE NEGATIVE IMPACT OF THE

PANDEMIC, PARTICULARLY THE LOSS OF MILLIONS OF LIVES AND

GROSS DISRUPTION TO SOCIOECONOMIC ACTIVITIES.



AS THE WORLD CONTINUES TO RECOVER FROM THE PANDEMIC,

IT IS NECESSARY TO FIND LASTING SOLUTIONS, INCLUDING

6



INVESTMENT  IN  RESILIENT  HEALTH  SYSTEMS  THAT  WILL

RESPOND TO FUTURE PANDEMICS OF THE LIKES THAT WE HAVE

WITNESSED WITH COVID-19, AMONG OTHERS.

THIS  ENTAILS  THE  ESTABLISHMENT  OF    A_  VERSATILE

INTERNATIONAL PUBLIC HEALTH REGIME THAT WILL BE DEVOID

OF HOARDING VACCINES AND RELATED TECHNOLOGIES TO

GUARANTEE RAPID DEPLOYMENT OF SUPPLIES FROM A GLOBAL

RESERVE TO TACKLE FUTURE PANDEMICS.



MR. PRESIDENT,



THE RE-EMERGENCE OF POLIO IN OUR WORLD, IS OF GREAT

CONCERN, AND  AS  SUCH,  ZAMBIA  IS  PARTICIPATING  IN

SUPPLEMENTARY IMMUNIZATION ACTIVITIES, ALONG WITH A

NUMBER OF COUNTRIES IN OUR REGION, IN ORDER TO PREVENT

AND HALT THE SPREAD OF THE WILD POLIO VIRUS TYPE ONE.




THIS IS IN ADDITION TO ON-GOING ACTIVITIES TO FIGHT OTHER

VACCINE PREVENTABLE DISEASES SUCH AS MEASLES; AS WELL AS

TO STRENGTHEN OUR ROUTINE IMMUNIZATION AND MAINTAIN

7



ESSENTIAL  HEALTH  SERVICES  FOR MATERNAL AND  CHILD

HEALTH.



AS THE GLOBAL CHOLERA CONTROL CHAMPION, WITH MANY

THANKS TO THE W.H.O, OUR FIGHT AGAINST CHOLERA MUST

CONTINUE WITH VIGOR.



WE ALSO NEED TO REMAIN ALERT TO ANY POSSIBLE OUTBREAKS

OF MONKEY POX, EBOLA VIRUS DISEASE AND OTHER THREATS.



THE INTERNATIONAL COMMUNITY MUST WORK TOGETHER TO

ADDRESS THE GROWING THREAT TO THE ENVIRONMENT, HUMAN

AND  ANIMAL  HEALTH  RESULTING  FROM  ANTIMICROBIAL

RESISTANCE, COMMONLY REFERRED TO AS "DRUG RESISTANCE”.



DRUG-RESISTANT BACTERIAL INFECTIONS CONTINUE TO CAUSE

MILLIONS OF DEATHS, WHERE SUB-SAHARAN AFRICA HAS THE

GREATEST  BURDEN  OF  RESISTANT-BACTERIAL  INFECTIONS,

ACCOUNTING FOR A GREATER PROPORTION OF DEATHS.

THIS CALLS FOR GREATER CONTROL SYSTEMS IN ACCESS TO

ANTIMICROBIAL MEDICINES FOR BOTH HUMAN AND ANIMAL USE.

8





I SHALL NOW FOCUS ON OTHER AREAS OF INTEREST.



1. ECONOMIC PERFORMANCE


MR. PRESIDENT,



THE UKRAINE CRISIS HAS HAMPERED THE RECOVERY THAT WAS

SLOWLY TAKING HOLD, PARTICULARLY IN THE DEVELOPING

WORLD WHERE  LARGE SECTIONS OF SOCIETY REMAIN  IN

EXTREME POVERTY AND INEQUALITIES WIDEN.



WITH THE ATTAINMENT OF THE SDGS, OFF-TRACK COUNTRIES

MUST INTENSIFY NATIONAL CONSULTATIVE PROCESSES AND

STAKEHOLDER ENGAGEMENTS AND RENEW COMMITMENTS TO

POVERTY ERADICATION, TACKLE ENERGY POVERTY, SUPPORT TO

DEBT RESTRUCTURING AND ENHANCED CONCESSIONAL FINANCE.



ON OUR PART, WE HEREBY INDICATE IN THIS REGARD, OUR

INTENTION TO PRESENT OUR SECOND VOLUNTARY NATIONAL

9


REVIEW (VNR) IN JULY 2023, TO HIGHLIGHT ZAMBIA’S PROGRESS

TOWARDS SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT GOALS.


DESPITE THE CHALLENGING  EXTERNAL ENVIRONMENT, OUR

RESOLVE  TO  REBUILD  THE  ZAMBIAN  ECONOMY  REMAINS

STRONG.



OUR ECONOMIC RECOVERY IS ON TRACK, AS EVIDENCED BY THE

POSITIVE GROWTH INDICATORS AND STABILIZATION OF KEY

MACROECONOMIC  VARIABLES,  SUCH  AS  INTEREST  RATES,

EXCHANGE RATE STABILITY, AND INFLATION, WHICH WE HAVE

BEEN ABLE TO REDUCE FROM 25% TO 9.8% IN ONE YEAR OF

BEING IN OFFICE.





MR. PRESIDENT,



ZAMBIA  IS ON A PATH OF GROWTH FROM THE ECONOMIC

CONTRACTION AT MINUS 2%, TO GDP GROWTH ESTIMATED AT

OVER 3% WITHIN ONE YEAR OF OUR TAKING OFFICE.

10





IN TERMS OF SOCIAL ECONOMIC BENEFITS, OUR COMMITMENT TO

PROVIDING  EQUAL  OPPORTUNITIES,  ESPECIALLY  FOR THE

YOUNG   PEOPLE   HAS   BEEN  DEMONSTRATED   BY  THE

INTRODUCTION OF FREE PRIMARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION,
AS WE BELIEVE THAT EDUCATION IS THE BEST EQUALIZER, THE
BEST INVESTMENT, AND THE BEST INHERITANCE, WITHOUT
DOUBT.


CONSISTENT WITH OUR PLEDGE TO INVEST IN HUMAN CAPITAL,
WE HAVE RECRUITED OVER 30,000 TEACHERS AND OVER 11,000

HEALTH WORKERS, IN 2022 ALONE.


WE  ARE  DECENTRALIZING  SERVICE  DELIVERY AND  HAVE

INCREASED  THE  ALLOCATION   OF  THE  CONSTITUENCY

DEVELOPMENT FUND BY OVER 1,000% IN OUR FIRST BUDGET IN

OFFICE.

11


EXPENDITURE OF THESE FUNDS AT COMMUNITY LEVEL IS MEANT

TO ENSURE INCLUSIVE AND SUSTAINABLE ECONOMIC GROWTH

THAT WILL SUPPORT SME DEVELOPMENT AND EMPLOYMENT

CREATION.

I AM PLEASED TO NOTE THAT WE HAVE REACHED IN PRINCIPLE,
AGREEMENT  WITH   CREDITORS  UNDER  THE  COMMON

FRAMEWORK  TO  RESTRUCTURE  THE  NATIONAL  DEBT WE

INHERITED AND HAVE CONCLUDED AN IMF DEAL BASED ON OUR

HOME-GROWN ECONOMIC TRANSFORMATION PLAN.


WE SAY MANY THANKS TO THE INTERNATIONAL MONETARY FUND,

WORLD BANK, UN SYSTEM AND OTHER COOPERATING PARTNERS

FOR YOUR SUPPORT.



2. CLIMATE CHANGE



MR. PRESIDENT,



THE ADVERSE EFFECTS OF CLIMATE CHANGE HAVE CONTINUED TO

RAVAGE OUR PLANET.

12


IN ADDRESSING THE EMERGING GLOBAL CRISIS ON CLIMATE

CHANGE, ALLOW ME TO CITE A SITUATION IN ZAMBIA, WHERE

RECENTLY, ONE HALF OF THE COUNTRY EXPERIENCED TOTAL

CROP FAILURE DUE TO EXTREME DROUGHT, WHILE THE OTHER

HALF EXPERIENCED FLOODING IN THE SAME SEASON.

SUCH EXTREME WEATHER EVENTS ARE A TIMELY REMINDER OF

THE GRAVE CONSEQUENCES OF CLIMATE CHANGE.


WE, THEREFORE, NEED ROBUST SOLUTIONS AND COHESION IN

OUR APPROACH AT THE GLOBAL AND REGIONAL LEVELS TO

ADDRESS THE EFFECTS OF CLIMATE CHANGE.


AS CHAIR OF THE AFRICAN GROUP OF NEGOTIATORS ON CLIMATE

CHANGE, ZAMBIA CALLS FOR ENHANCED GLOBAL EFFORTS IN

ADDRESSING  CLIMATE  CHANGE,  WHICH  SHOULD  INCLUDE

INCREASED FINANCIAL SUPPORT FOR COUNTRIES WITH LIMITED

RESOURCES TO MITIGATE AND ADAPT TO THE EFFECTS AND

IMPACT OF CLIMATE CHANGE.



ZAMBIA HAS MAINSTREAMED GREEN GROWTH AND CLIMATE

CHANGE-PROOFING IN THE CURRENT NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT

13



PLAN, WHICH HAS ARTICULATED BROAD POLICY MEASURES ON

TRANSITIONING  ZAMBIA  INTO A  CLIMATE-RESILIENT AND

INCLUSIVE GREEN ECONOMY.





3. GENDER



MR. PRESIDENT,


ZAMBIA  HAS CONTINUED TO  BUILD ON THE  EFFORTS OF

ATTAINING  GENDER  EQUALITY AND  INCLUSIVITY  IN  THE

VARIOUS SECTORS OF OUR SOCIETY.


BASED ON EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE, WOMEN EMPOWERMENT AND

POVERTY ALLEVIATION ARE POSITIVELY CORRELATED.



IT   IS,  THEREFORE,  IMPERATIVE  THAT   WE_  DEDICATE

CORRESPONDING   EFFORTS  TO  ENSURE  THAT  GENDER

DISPARITIES ARE CURTAILED.

14


ZAMBIA, UNDER OUR NATIONAL GENDER POLICY, HAS BEEN

IMPLEMENTING AFFIRMATIVE ACTION, IN FAVOUR OF WOMEN

AND  GIRLS, TO ENSURE THAT THEIR  FULL POTENTIAL  IS

REALISED.





4. ENDING CHILD MARRIAGE


TO COMPLEMENT THESE MEASURES, ZAMBIA IS CHAMPIONING

THE CAMPAIGN TO END CHILD MARRIAGE IN AFRICA.


IN THE SAME VEIN, WE ARE PROUD TO INFORM THIS ASSEMBLY

THAT  THIS  MORNING,   ZAMBIA,  CANADA  AND  OTHER

COOPERATING PARTNERS HELD A SIDE EVENT TO GALVANISE

SUPPORT AND RENEW COMMITMENT FROM THE INTERNATIONAL

COMMUNITY TOWARDS ENDING CHILD, EARLY AND FORCED

MARRIAGE.



WITH THE ASSURANCES MADE DURING THIS EVENT, WE ARE

HOPEFUL THAT WE SHALL BE ABLE TO ACHIEVE THE SUSTAINABLE

15



DEVELOPMENT GOAL ON GENDER EQUALITY, (TARGET 5.3) THAT

AIMS AT ELIMINATING THIS HARMFUL PRACTICE.





5. INTERNATIONAL PEACE, SECURITY AND STABILITY



MR. PRESIDENT,



THE WORLD  AT  LARGE  HAS  GRAPPLED  WITH  GROWING

INSTABILITY AND INSECURITY WITHIN THE LAST YEAR, AND THE

EFFECTS HAVE BEEN FELT BY MILLIONS OF PEOPLE AROUND THE

WORLD AS LIVES AND LIVELIHOODS HAVE BEEN LOST.



ZAMBIA BELIEVES THAT WITHOUT PEACE AND STABILITY, OUR

JOINT DEVELOPMENTAL EFFORTS ARE IN VAIN.

16


AS SUCH, WE ARE COMMITTED TO REMAIN STRONG ADVOCATES

OF PEACE AND STABILITY IN SOUTHERN AFRICA, THE ENTIRE

AFRICAN CONTINENT AND THE WORLD OVER.



OUR GUIDING PRINCIPLE THAT “INSTABILITY ANYWHERE, IS

INSTABILITY EVERYWHERE” REMINDS US THAT ENDING WAR

AND CONFLICT IS NOT ONLY THE RESPONSIBILITY OF THOSE

DIRECTLY INVOLVED  IN THE  CONFLICT,  BUT THE SHARED

OBLIGATION OF EVERY GLOBAL CITIZEN AND INDEED EVERY

NATION — I MEAN ALL OF US WITHOUT EXCEPTION.

WE, THEREFORE TAKE THIS MATTER SERIOUSLY AND SHALL

CONTINUE TO ACTIVELY PARTICIPATE IN EFFORTS TO RESTORE

PEACE IN ALL THE TROUBLED REGIONS OF OUR CONTINENT.



AS THE IN-COMING CHAIR OF THE SADC ORGAN ON POLITICS,

DEFENCE  AND  SECURITY  COOPERATION,  ZAMBIA  WILL

PRIORITIZE THE RESTORATION OF PEACE AND STABILITY IN OUR

COUNTRY AND REGION.



AS IT IS SAID, CHARITY BEGINS AT HOME.

17



AT THE CONTINENTAL LEVEL, ZAMBIA REMAINS ENGAGED AND

COMMITTED TO THE EFFORTS OF THE AFRICAN UNION AND THE

UNITED NATIONS  IN PROMOTING  PEACE  IN THE VARIOUS

CONFLICT AREAS.



GOING FORWARD OUR UN SYSTEM SHOULD TILT MORE EFFORTS

TOWARDS PREVENTION OF CONFLICTS, WHICH IS MORE COST

EFFECTIVE AND PALATABLE.



ZAMBIA AS A SIGNATORY TO VARIOUS DISARMAMENT TREATIES

AND CONVENTIONS  REMAINS COMMITTED TO  PROMOTING

GLOBAL PEACE AND SECURITY.



MR. PRESIDENT,



ZAMBIA JOINS WITH OTHER GOVERNMENTS IN EXPRESSING

PARTICULAR CONCERN ABOUT THE ONGOING WAR IN UKRAINE.



AS WE STAND WITH ALL THOSE AFFECTED, BOTH IN UKRAINE AND

IN  NEIGHBOURING  COUNTRIES,  WE  ALSO  TAKE  THIS

OPPORTUNITY TO STRESS THE FAR-REACHING AND NEGATIVE

18


CONSEQUENCES OF THIS WAR, PARTICULARLY ON THE PRICES OF

FOOD, FUEL, FERTILISER AND OTHER KEY COMMODITIES,


WAR, IN ANY PART OF THE WORLD, HAS DAMAGING EFFECTS ON

ECONOMIC ACTIVITY, WHICH DERAILS OUR COLLECTIVE FIGHT

AGAINST POVERTY AND HUNGER.



A FEW MONTHS OF WAR CAN ERASE DECADES OF PROGRESS.

WE, THEREFORE, CATEGORICALLY CONDEMN WAR ANYWHERE

AND WE CONTINUE TO URGE ALL PARTIES INVOLVED TO PURSUE

DIPLOMATIC SOLUTIONS TO CONFLICT.




OUR UN SHOULD CONTINUE WITH ITS PEACE EFFORTS.




6. UN REFORMS



WE WISH TO STRESS THAT GLOBAL AMBITIONS TOWARDS PEACE

AND SECURITY LARGELY DEPEND ON THE EFFECTIVENESS OF THE

UNITED NATIONS SECURITY COUNCIL.

19


THE INADEQUACIES OF THE CURRENT STRUCTURE OF THE

SECURITY COUNCIL, HOWEVER, HAVE BECOME INCREASINGLY

PRONOUNCED WITH CEDING OF DECISION-MAKING ON MATTERS

OF GLOBAL PEACE AND SECURITY TO THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY

THAT OTHERWISE WOULD HAVE BEEN ITS PRESERVE.



THIS BRINGS TO THE FORE THE NEED FOR THE LONG OVERDUE

REFORMS OF THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL.



WE, THEREFORE, CONTINUE TO ADVANCE THE AFRICAN COMMON

POSITION, AS ESPOUSED IN THE “EZULWINI CONSENSUS” AND

THE SIRTE  DECLARATION, TO ENSURE THE  EFFECTIVENESS,

CREDIBILITY AND LEGITIMACY OF THE UN SECURITY COUNCIL.




CONCLUSION



IN CONCLUSION,  MR.  PRESIDENT, WE WISH TO REAFFIRM

ZAMBIA’S COMMITMENT TO THE FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES ON

WHICH  THE  UNITED  NATIONS  WAS  FOUNDED,  WHICH

SAFEGUARD OUR SHARED FUTURE OF PEACE AND PROSPERITY

FOR ALL NATIONS.

20





I THANK YOU FOR YOUR KIND ATTENTION.
